-- test: threaddump basic --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} threaddump
-- expect:regex --
Total Threads: \d+
-- expect:regex --
Thread #\d+:
-- expect:regex --
(RUNNABLE|WAITING|TIMED_WAITING|BLOCKED)
-- expect:regex --
at\s+[a-zA-Z0-9._$]+\.[a-zA-Z0-9_$]+\(


-- test: threaddump filter by state --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} threaddump --state RUNNABLE
-- expect:regex --
Total Threads: \d+
-- expect --
Showing
-- expect --
filtered threads
-- expect --
State: RUNNABLE


-- test: threaddump filter by name --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} threaddump --filter http
-- expect:regex --
Total Threads: \d+
-- expect --
Showing
-- expect --
filtered threads
-- expect:regex --
http.*nio


-- test: threaddump filter by quoted name with space --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} threaddump --filter "Reference Handler"
-- expect --
Reference Handler
-- expect --
filtered threads
-- expect:not --
http-nio


-- test: threaddump wide shows priority and full traces --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} threaddump -o wide --filter scheduling
-- expect --
Thread #
-- expect --
Priority:
-- expect:not --
more frames


-- test: threaddump without stacktraces --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} threaddump --no-stacktrace --filter scheduling
-- expect --
Thread #
-- expect:not --
Stack Trace:


-- test: threaddump summary mode --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod}} threaddump --summary
-- expect:regex --
Total Threads: \d+
-- expect --
Thread States:
-- expect:regex --
RUNNABLE: \d+
-- expect:not --
Thread #
-- expect:not --
Stack Trace:


-- test: threaddump multi-pod --
-- command --
kubectl-actuator --pod {{pod[0]}} --pod {{pod[1]}} threaddump
-- expect:regex --
{{pod[0]}}:
-- expect:regex --
(Thread|threads|Total Threads:)
